name: Weak consistency of the Hill estimator
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_hill.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => (P {ω | x < X 0 ω}).toReal) (-α))
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => 1 / α
scope_note: Consistency only; Mason's converse is not claimed. No positivity assumption, as in dHF: logs of nonpositive order statistics are junk values only on an event of vanishing probability.

name: Asymptotic normality of the Hill estimator
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_hill.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω' : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i))
  (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {γ ρ lam : ℝ} {A : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hγ : 0 < γ)
  (h2 :
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsSecondOrderRegularlyVarying
      (ExtremeValueTheory.survivalQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))) γ ρ A)
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hlam : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => √↑(k n) * A (↑n / ↑(k n))) Filter.atTop (nhds lam)) {Z : Ω' → ℝ}
  (hZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (lam / (1 - ρ)) (γ ^ 2).toNNReal)
      P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω => √↑(k n) * (ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) - γ)) Filter.atTop Z
    (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: The definition of second-order regular variation builds in that |A| is RV_rho and has constant sign, which dHF derive when the limit is non-degenerate.

name: Asymptotic normality of the Hill estimator, exact Pareto
scope_note: Exact Pareto samples only. It needs only k < n, not k/n -> 0, which is the part beyond the cited theorem.

name: Hill consistency from a variance bound on exceedance counts
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_hill_of_variance.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i))
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => (P {ω | x < X 0 ω}).toReal) (-α))
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hvar :
    ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      0 < c →
        Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * (P {ω | u n < X 0 ω}).toReal / ↑(k n)) Filter.atTop
              (nhds c) →
            Filter.Tendsto
              (fun n =>
                ProbabilityTheory.variance (ExtremeValueTheory.tailCount X n (u n)) P / ↑(k n) ^ 2)
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => 1 / α
scope_note: The key step for dependent data is assumed: the variance bound on exceedance counts, along every level sequence, is a hypothesis. It reduces dependence to that bound and says nothing about which processes satisfy it.

name: Hill consistency for m-dependent sequences
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_hill_of_isMDependent.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {m : ℕ}
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) (hdep : ProbabilityTheory.IsMDependent X m P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => (P {ω | x < X 0 ω}).toReal) (-α))
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => 1 / α
scope_note: The variance bound is derived from m-dependence, and only identical marginals are needed, not stationarity.

name: Hill consistency under strong mixing, with a rate
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_hill_of_alphaMixing_rate.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) (hstat : ProbabilityTheory.IsStationary X P)
  {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => (P {ω | x < X 0 ω}).toReal) (-α))
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (r : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hclus :
    ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      0 < c →
        Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * (P {ω | u n < X 0 ω}).toReal / ↑(k n)) Filter.atTop
              (nhds c) →
            Filter.Tendsto
              (fun n =>
                (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (r n), P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω ∧ u n < X h ω}) /
                    (P {ω | u n < X 0 ω}).toReal /
                  ↑(k n))
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hmix :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => (↑n / ↑(k n)) ^ 2 * (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing X P (r n + 1)).toReal)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => 1 / α
scope_note: The cluster condition is assumed along every level sequence, not derived from the tail process, and the mixing rate (n/k)^2 alpha(r+1) -> 0 is a simple sufficient one, not the sharpest.

name: Hill consistency under S(r_n, u_n) and strong mixing
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_hill_of_alphaMixing_of_sumAntiClustering.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) (hstat : ProbabilityTheory.IsStationary X P)
  {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => (P {ω | x < X 0 ω}).toReal) (-α))
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (r : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hS :
    ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      0 < c →
        Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * (P {ω | u n < X 0 ω}).toReal / ↑(k n)) Filter.atTop
              (nhds c) →
            ExtremeValueTheory.SumAntiClusteringAt P X u r)
  (hmix :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        ↑n / ↑(k n) ^ 2 *
          ∑ h ∈ Finset.Ico (r n + 1) n, (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing X P h).toReal)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => 1 / α
scope_note: The condition S(r_n, u_n) is assumed along every level sequence and has no concrete instance in the library; the mixing condition is a sufficient rate. Not checked against the wording in KS20.

name: Weak consistency of the Pickands estimator
scope_note: Every xi. Consistency only: the asymptotic normality in EKM's theorem is not stated. Indices are shifted by one against EKM.

name: Weak consistency of the moment estimator
scope_note: Every gamma, x_F > 0 as in dHF. Consistency only.

name: Ratio consistency of the Weissman estimator at intermediate levels
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_weissman_div.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => (P {ω | x < X 0 ω}).toReal) (-α))
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) {p : ℕ → ℝ}
  (hp0 : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < p n) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
  (hd : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(k n) / (↑n * p n) ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P
    (fun n ω =>
      ExtremeValueTheory.weissman (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) (p n) /
        ExtremeValueTheory.upperQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0)) (p n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => 1
scope_note: Only p_n comparable to k/n: no extrapolation beyond the sample range, which is the point of the estimator.

name: Consistency of the Weissman estimator beyond the sample
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_weissman_div_of_secondOrder.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {γ ρ lam : ℝ} {A : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hγ : 0 < γ) (hρ : ρ < 0)
  (h2 :
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsSecondOrderRegularlyVarying
      (ExtremeValueTheory.survivalQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))) γ ρ A)
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hlam : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => √↑(k n) * A (↑n / ↑(k n))) Filter.atTop (nhds lam)) {p : ℕ → ℝ}
  (hp0 : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < p n)
  (hd1 : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ ↑(k n) / (↑n * p n))
  (hd : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (↑(k n) / (↑n * p n)) / √↑(k n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P
    (fun n ω =>
      ExtremeValueTheory.weissman (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) (p n) /
        ExtremeValueTheory.upperQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0)) (p n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => 1
scope_note: gamma > 0 and rho < 0 only. The case rho = 0 of consistency, and gamma <= 0, are not covered here.

name: Asymptotic normality of the Weissman estimator
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_weissman.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω' : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i))
  (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {γ ρ lam : ℝ} {A : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hγ : 0 < γ) (hρ : ρ < 0)
  (h2 :
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsSecondOrderRegularlyVarying
      (ExtremeValueTheory.survivalQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))) γ ρ A)
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hlam : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => √↑(k n) * A (↑n / ↑(k n))) Filter.atTop (nhds lam)) {p : ℕ → ℝ}
  (hp0 : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < p n)
  (hd : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / (↑n * p n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hdk : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (↑(k n) / (↑n * p n)) / √↑(k n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  {Z : Ω' → ℝ}
  (hZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (lam / (1 - ρ)) (γ ^ 2).toNNReal)
      P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω =>
      √↑(k n) / Real.log (↑(k n) / (↑n * p n)) *
        (ExtremeValueTheory.weissman (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) (p n) /
            ExtremeValueTheory.upperQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0)) (p n) -
          1))
    Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: gamma > 0 and rho < 0 only; rho = 0 is the separate entry weissman-normality-rho-zero.

name: Asymptotic normality of the Weissman estimator at rho = 0
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_weissman_of_rho_eq_zero.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i))
  (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {γ lam : ℝ} {A : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hγ : 0 < γ)
  (h2 :
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsSecondOrderRegularlyVarying
      (ExtremeValueTheory.survivalQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))) γ 0 A)
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hlam : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => √↑(k n) * A (↑n / ↑(k n))) Filter.atTop (nhds lam)) {p : ℕ → ℝ}
  (hp0 : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < p n)
  (hd : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / (↑n * p n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hdk : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (↑(k n) / (↑n * p n)) / √↑(k n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  {η : ℕ → ℝ} (hη : Filter.Tendsto η Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hAη :
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (↑n / ↑(k n)) (p n)⁻¹, |A y / A (↑n / ↑(k n)) - 1| ≤ η n)
  {Z : Ω' → ℝ}
  (hZ : ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (γ ^ 2).toNNReal) P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω =>
      √↑(k n) / Real.log (↑(k n) / (↑n * p n)) *
        (ExtremeValueTheory.weissman (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) (p n) /
            ExtremeValueTheory.upperQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0)) (p n) -
          1))
    Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: Assumes A asymptotically constant on the extrapolation range, an extra hypothesis. Not checked against the text of dHF at rho = 0.

name: Asymptotic normality of the tail probability estimator
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_tailProbEstimator.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω' : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i))
  (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {γ ρ lam : ℝ} {A : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hγ : 0 < γ) (hρ : ρ < 0)
  (h2 :
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsSecondOrderRegularlyVarying
      (ExtremeValueTheory.survivalQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))) γ ρ A)
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hlam : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => √↑(k n) * A (↑n / ↑(k n))) Filter.atTop (nhds lam)) {y : ℕ → ℝ}
  (he :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        y n / ExtremeValueTheory.upperQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0)) (↑(k n) / ↑n))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hek :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        Real.log
            (y n /
              ExtremeValueTheory.upperQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))
                (↑(k n) / ↑n)) /
          √↑(k n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  {Z : Ω' → ℝ}
  (hZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (lam / ((1 - ρ) * γ ^ 2)) (γ⁻¹ ^ 2).toNNReal) P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω =>
      √↑(k n) /
          Real.log
            (y n /
              ExtremeValueTheory.upperQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))
                (↑(k n) / ↑n)) *
        (ExtremeValueTheory.tailProbEstimator (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) (y n) /
            (P {ω | y n < X 0 ω}).toReal -
          1))
    Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: gamma > 0 and rho < 0 only: heavy tails, while the theorem cited covers the general index.

name: Consistency of the block maxima method
scope_note: The normalizing constants are known and given, at one point x. It is the empirical c.d.f. of normalized block maxima, with no parameter estimated.

name: L-skewness of the GEV law, Hosking's form
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.lSkewness_gevCDF_hosking {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ < 1) (h0 : ξ ≠ 0) :
  ExtremeValueTheory.lSkewness (ExtremeValueTheory.gevCDF ξ).measure =
    2 * (1 - 3 ^ (- -ξ)) / (1 - 2 ^ (- -ξ)) - 3
scope_note: Standard law; xi < 1, xi != 0. The library's xi is Hosking's -k.

name: Strong consistency of the sample probability-weighted moments
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.ae_tendsto_samplePWM.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ExtremeValueTheory.samplePWM (fun i => X i ω) n r) Filter.atTop

name: Strong consistency of the PWM estimator of the GPD shape
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.ae_tendsto_gpdPWMShapeEst.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}

name: Strong consistency of the PWM estimator of the GPD scale
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.ae_tendsto_gpdPWMScaleEst.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {ξ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hξ : ξ < 1)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ σ) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) :
  ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P,

      (nhds σ)

name: Functional CLT for the uniform tail empirical process
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_tailEmpiricalPath.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {U : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {k : ℕ → ℕ}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (hU : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (U i))
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun U P)
  (hlaw :
    ∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (U i) P = MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 1))
  (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) {Ω' : Type u_2}
  {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P']
  {B : Ω' → SkorokhodSpace ℝ} (hB : Measurable B)
  (hBfdd :
    ∀ (J : Finset ↑unitInterval),
      MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x t => x ↑t) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map B P') =
        ExtremeValueTheory.brownianFdd fun t => unitInterval.toNNReal' ↑t) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun n => ExtremeValueTheory.tailEmpiricalPath U n (k n))
    Filter.atTop B (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: Uniform samples and unweighted: the process for regularly varying F and the weighted (Chibisov-O'Reilly) form in dHF are not covered.

name: Weighted bound for the tail empirical process near 0
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.exists_eventually_measureReal_weighted_le.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {U : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hU : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (U i)) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun U P)
  (hlaw :
    ∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (U i) P = MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 1))
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) {η : ℝ} (hη0 : 0 < η)
  {ε θ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
  ∃ δ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1,
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      P.real
          {ω |
            ∃ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 δ,
              ε * t ^ (1 / 2 - η) < |ExtremeValueTheory.tailEmpiricalProcess U n (k n) t ω|} ≤
        θ
scope_note: Only the tail estimate near 0, for uniform samples, not full weighted weak convergence.

name: Consistency of the disjoint blocks estimator
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_blocksEstimator.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hX : ∀ (t : ℕ), Measurable (X t)) (hs : ProbabilityTheory.IsStationary X P) {u : ℕ → ℝ}
  {r : ℕ → ℕ} {θ : ℝ} (hr : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < r n)
  (hrn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hk : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω}) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hθ :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        P.real (ExtremeValueTheory.blockEvent X (r n) 0 (u n)) /
          (↑(r n) * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω}))
      Filter.atTop (nhds θ))
  (s : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hclus :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (s n), P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω ∧ u n < X h ω}) /
          (↑n * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω} ^ 2))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hmix :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (∑ h ∈ Finset.Ico (s n + 1) n, (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing X P h).toReal) /
          (↑n * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω} ^ 2))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hmixB :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing X P (r n + 1)).toReal /
          (↑(r n) * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω}) ^ 2)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n => ExtremeValueTheory.blocksEstimator X n (r n) (u n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => θ
scope_note: The limit of the block cluster ratio is assumed, not derived: the conclusion is convergence to that assumed population target. Cluster and mixing rates are hypotheses too.

name: Consistency of the runs estimator
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_runsEstimator.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hX : ∀ (t : ℕ), Measurable (X t)) (hs : ProbabilityTheory.IsStationary X P) {u : ℕ → ℝ}
  {r : ℕ → ℕ} {θ : ℝ} (hrn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hk : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω}) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hθ :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => P.real (ExtremeValueTheory.runEvent X (r n) 0 (u n)) / P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω})
      Filter.atTop (nhds θ))
  (s : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hclus :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (r n + s n), P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω ∧ u n < X h ω}) /
          (↑n * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω} ^ 2))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hmix :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (∑ h ∈ Finset.Ico (s n + 1) n, (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing X P h).toReal) /
          (↑n * P.real {ω | u n < X 0 ω} ^ 2))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n => ExtremeValueTheory.runsEstimator X n (r n) (u n))
    Filter.atTop fun x => θ
scope_note: The limit of the runs ratio is assumed, not derived, and the cluster and mixing rates are hypotheses.

name: The blocks estimator converges to the candidate extremal index
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralTailProcess.tendstoInMeasure_blocksEstimator.{u_2, u_3} {Ω : Type u_2}
  {Ω' : Type u_3} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℤ → Ω → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {Θ : ℤ → Ω' → ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  (hX : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (X t)) (hΘm : ∀ (t : ℤ), Measurable (Θ t))
  (hstat : ExtremeValueTheory.HasShiftInvariantWindows P X)
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralTailProcess P X α Q Θ) {u : ℕ → ℝ}
  (hu : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) {r : ℕ → ℕ}
  (hr : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hAC : ExtremeValueTheory.ForwardAntiClusteringAt P X u r)
  (hrn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hk : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * P.real {ω | u n < |X 0 ω|}) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (s : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hclus :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (s n), P.real {ω | u n < |X 0 ω| ∧ u n < |X (↑h) ω|}) /
          (↑n * P.real {ω | u n < |X 0 ω|} ^ 2))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hmix :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (∑ h ∈ Finset.Ico (s n + 1) n,
            (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing (fun k => |X ↑k|) P h).toReal) /
          (↑n * P.real {ω | u n < |X 0 ω|} ^ 2))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hmixB :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (ProbabilityTheory.alphaMixing (fun k => |X ↑k|) P (r n + 1)).toReal /
          (↑(r n) * P.real {ω | u n < |X 0 ω|}) ^ 2)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P
    (fun n => ExtremeValueTheory.blocksEstimator (fun k => |X ↑k|) n (r n) (u n)) Filter.atTop
    fun x => (ExtremeValueTheory.candidateExtremalIndex Q Θ α).toReal
scope_note: The target is now the candidate index, by anticlustering, but anticlustering and the cluster and mixing rates are all hypotheses, for |X|. Equal to theta only under the block condition as well.

statement:

name: Consistency of the intervals estimator from the moments
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInMeasure_intervalsEstimator₁.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {m : ℕ → ℕ} (hm : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < m n)
  {T : (n : ℕ) → Ω → Fin (m n) → ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} (hc : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, c n ≠ 0) {θ : ℝ}
  (hθ0 : 0 < θ)
  (h1 :
    MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => (∑ i, c n * T n ω i) / ↑(m n)) Filter.atTop
      fun x => ∫ (x : ℝ), x ∂ExtremeValueTheory.ferroSegersLaw θ)
  (h2 :
    MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => (∑ i, (c n * T n ω i) ^ 2) / ↑(m n)) Filter.atTop
      fun x => ∫ (x : ℝ), x ^ 2 ∂ExtremeValueTheory.ferroSegersLaw θ) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P (fun n ω => ExtremeValueTheory.intervalsEstimator₁ (T n ω))
    Filter.atTop fun x => θ
scope_note: The whole probabilistic content is assumed: convergence of the first and second empirical moments of the inter-exceedance times is a hypothesis, which contains both the Ferro-Segers limit law and a law of large numbers. What is proved is the algebra from those moments to the estimator. Inter-exceedance times are abstract, not built from a process.

name: Asymptotic confidence interval for the tail index
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendsto_measure_mem_hillInterval.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {γ ρ : ℝ} {A : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hγ : 0 < γ)
  (h2 :
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsSecondOrderRegularlyVarying
      (ExtremeValueTheory.survivalQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))) γ ρ A)
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => √↑(k n) * A (↑n / ↑(k n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (z : ℝ) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      P
        {ω |
          γ ∈
            Set.Icc
              (ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) -
                z * ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) / √↑(k n))
              (ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) +
                z * ExtremeValueTheory.hill (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) / √↑(k n))})
    Filter.atTop (nhds ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Icc (-z) z)))
scope_note: Wald interval under sqrt(k) A(n/k) -> 0, the condition under which it is valid; a bias-corrected interval is not stated.

name: Asymptotic normality of the Pickands estimator
source: dHF Thm 3.3.5 (from memory, not checked against the book)
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_pickands.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω' : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i))
  (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {γ ρ lam : ℝ} {a A : ℝ → ℝ}
  (h2 :
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsExtSecondOrderRegularlyVarying
      (ExtremeValueTheory.survivalQuantile (ExtremeValueTheory.survival P (X 0))) γ ρ a A)
  {k : ℕ → ℕ} (hk : Filter.Tendsto k Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hkn : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(k n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (hlam : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => √↑(k n) * A (↑n / ↑(k n))) Filter.atTop (nhds lam)) {Z : Ω' → ℝ}
  (hZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (lam * ExtremeValueTheory.pickandsBias γ ρ)
        (ExtremeValueTheory.pickandsVariance γ).toNNReal)
      P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω => √↑(k n) * (ExtremeValueTheory.pickands (fun i => X (↑i) ω) (k n) - γ)) Filter.atTop
    Z (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: Every shape. The second-order hypothesis assumes locally uniform convergence, formally stronger than the pointwise textbook condition, and k indexes X_(k), X_(2k), X_(4k).
